# Vapi

## Instructions for AI Agents

- For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
- For section-specific indexes, append `/llms.txt` to any section URL
- For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://docs.vapi.ai/_mcp/server

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.vapi.ai/quickstart/introduction.md): Get started with Vapi, the developer platform for building voice AI agents that make and receive phone calls, handling the infrastructure so you can build.
- [Phone calls](https://docs.vapi.ai/quickstart/phone.md): Make your first Vapi phone call in minutes, creating a voice agent in the Dashboard or programmatically and talking to it over the phone.
- [Web calls](https://docs.vapi.ai/quickstart/web.md): Build voice interfaces and backend integrations with Vapi's Web and Server SDKs, covering client-side voice apps and server-side call management.
- [Guides](https://docs.vapi.ai/guides.md): Browse real-world, cloneable Vapi examples that build voice agents with assistants and squads, from appointment booking to multilingual support routing.
- [Composer](https://docs.vapi.ai/composer.md): Build and configure Vapi voice agents through natural conversation with Composer, which creates assistants, sets up numbers and integrations, and troubleshoots.
- [Vapi CLI](https://docs.vapi.ai/cli.md): Command-line interface for building voice AI applications faster
- [Assistants quickstart](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/quickstart.md): Build your first Vapi assistant, connect it to a phone number, and make a call, working through the steps in the Dashboard or with the Vapi API.
- [Transient vs permanent configurations](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/concepts/transient-vs-permanent-configurations.md): Choose between transient inline and permanent stored assistant configurations in Vapi, and learn when each fits for flexibility, reusability, and management.
- [Variables](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/dynamic-variables.md): Personalize Vapi assistant prompts and messages with dynamic variables in double curly braces, setting values at call time through assistantOverrides.
- [Multilingual support](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/multilingual.md): Configure multilingual voice AI agents with automatic language detection, cross-language conversation, and localized voices
- [Personalization with user information](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/personalization.md): Personalize Vapi conversations with customer-specific data your server supplies at call time, tailoring responses for support, account management, and more.
- [Voice formatting plan](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/voice-formatting-plan.md): Format Vapi LLM output for natural-sounding speech, expanding numbers, currency, and symbols so text-to-speech reads them clearly, enabled by default.
- [Flush syntax](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/flush-syntax.md): Force immediate voice transmission with VAPI's flush syntax for real-time interactions
- [Background messages](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/background-messages.md): Silently add information to a Vapi call's chat history without notifying the user, logging button presses, actions, or context updates during the conversation.
- [Idle messages](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/idle-messages.md): Keep users engaged during Vapi call pauses with idle messages that trigger on customer silence, using fixed text or model-generated prompts via assistant hooks.
- [Assistant hooks](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/assistant-hooks.md): Automate actions on Vapi call events like ending and speech interruptions, using assistant hooks to transfer calls, run functions, or send messages.
- [Call timeout settings](https://docs.vapi.ai/documentation/assistants/conversation-behavior/call-timeout-settings.md): Configure silence and maximum-duration timeouts for assistants, distinguish inactivity from total call duration, and troubleshoot timeout call endings.
- [Keypad input settings](https://docs.vapi.ai/documentation/assistants/conversation-behavior/keypad-input-settings.md): Keypad input settings let assistants collect caller-entered digits. Configure timeouts and delimiters for menus, codes, and account information during calls.
- [End call phrases](https://docs.vapi.ai/documentation/assistants/conversation-behavior/end-call-phrases.md): End call phrases let assistants end calls after saying configured text. Choose reliable phrases and prevent unintended transcript matches during calls.
- [Background speech denoising](https://docs.vapi.ai/documentation/assistants/conversation-behavior/background-speech-denoising.md): Filter out noise and background speech while users are talking
- [Pronunciation dictionaries](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/pronunciation-dictionaries.md): Control how a Vapi assistant pronounces specific words, names, and acronyms using pronunciation dictionaries with phoneme and alias rules by voice provider.
- [Email address reading](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/email-address-reading.md): Get a Vapi voice agent to collect, read back, and confirm email addresses clearly, using built-in TTS formatting, prompting, and confirmation techniques.
- [Speech configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/speech-configuration.md): Control when a Vapi assistant starts and stops speaking, tuning speech settings to sound natural, avoid interrupting the customer, and reduce awkward pauses.
- [Voice pipeline configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/voice-pipeline-configuration.md): Complete guide to configuring VAPI's voice pipeline for optimal conversation timing and interruption handling
- [Voice fallback configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/voice-fallback-plan.md): Configure fallback voices in Vapi that activate automatically when your primary voice provider fails, switching through your ordered list to keep calls live.
- [Transcriber fallback configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/transcriber-fallback-plan.md): Configure fallback transcribers so calls keep working if your primary speech-to-text provider fails. Covers automatic fallback, manual fallback, and HIPAA-compliant provider options.
- [OpenAI Realtime](https://docs.vapi.ai/openai-realtime.md): Build Vapi voice assistants on OpenAI's Realtime speech-to-speech models for low latency, covering model choice, configuration, and production best practices.
- [Provider Keys](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/provider-keys.md): Connect provider credentials in Vapi and find configuration details for transcriber, model, voice, and cloud providers.
- [Versioning](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/versioning.md): Versioning saves published assistant and tool configurations so you can make changes in a draft, review their history, and restore an earlier version.
- [Versioning with assistants](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/versioning/versioning-assistants.md): Publish assistant changes, review version history, restore an earlier configuration as a new current version, and select the published assistant version for a call.
- [Versioning with tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/versioning/versioning-tools.md): Publish tool changes, review version history, restore an earlier configuration to the draft, and select the specific tool version that an assistant uses.
- [How versioning works with assistants and tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/versioning/versioning-with-assistants-and-tools.md): Select a specific or latest tool version for an assistant, and learn how restoring an assistant also restores the tool version selections saved with it.
- [Model Intelligence for transcribers, models, and voices](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/overview.md): Model Intelligence helps you choose transcribers, models, and voices with curated presets and weekly refreshed performance metrics for latency, cost, and quality.
- [Model Presets for transcribers, models, and voices](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/presets.md): Model presets optimize for balanced performance, reasoning, low latency, or low cost. Learn when to use each preset and how to apply or customize its configuration.
- [Performance metrics and methodology reference](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/metrics-methodology.md): The performance metrics reference explains how Vapi sources and calculates latency, cost, and quality data for each supported transcriber, model, and voice.
- [How voice agent component costs and estimates work](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/understanding-cost.md): Understand how Vapi estimates transcriber, model, and voice costs per minute, including prompt caching assumptions and the effects of conversation history.
- [How voice-to-voice latency works in voice agents](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/understanding-latency.md): Understand voice-to-voice latency, the components included in Vapi performance metrics, and how model capability, endpointing, and transport affect response time.
- [Tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools.md): Learn what a Vapi tool is, how a tool call flows between the model, Vapi, and your server, which tool types exist, and the configuration every tool shares.
- [Built-in tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/default-tools.md): Add Vapi's built-in default tools to assistants, including transfer call, end call, SMS, DTMF keypad, and API request, through the API or dashboard.
- [When to use API Request or Function tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request-vs-function.md): Compare Vapi's API Request and Function tools, choosing API Request for direct HTTPS APIs and Function for tool-calls webhooks or async and client-side execution.
- [API Request tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request.md): Learn when to use an API Request Tool, how requests move between an assistant and an HTTP endpoint, and how to build your first working integration with Vapi.
- [API Request tool quickstart](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/quickstart.md): Build a coffee-order assistant that sends confirmed orders to a public endpoint and reads the server-calculated total and order number back to the caller.
- [Customize API Request tool requests](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/configuration.md): Configure an API Request Tool's URL, method, model-generated body, request headers, static body fields, and Liquid values with Dashboard and cURL examples.
- [Get order status](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/order-status.md): Add an order-status API Request Tool to the coffee-order assistant, update its opening and system prompt, and verify status lookup across two inbound calls.
- [Handle API Request tool latency and retries](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/reliability.md): Configure API Request Tool timeouts, retry backoff, excluded status codes, and caller messages for slow or failed HTTP requests with practical cURL examples.
- [Handle API Request tool responses and errors](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/response-handling.md): Handle successful and failed API Request Tool responses, test structured errors, guide assistant recovery, and inspect call results in the Dashboard or with cURL.
- [Use API Request tool response data](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/response-data.md): Use API Request Tool JSON responses immediately, extract response fields with schemas or aliases, and pass extracted variables to subsequent tools.
- [Function tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/custom-tools.md): Create custom tools, including Function tools, for Vapi assistants using the dashboard's visual Tools section or the API to connect to your server-side logic.
- [Transfer Call tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/transfer-call.md): Create a transfer call tool in the Vapi Dashboard or API, add it to an assistant, configure destinations, and troubleshoot invocation and routing failures.
- [Configure blind transfer modes](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/transfer-call/blind-transfer.md): Configure blind call transfers in the Vapi Dashboard or API, choose a SIP transfer method, add a summary header, verify routing, and diagnose failures.
- [Configure warm transfer modes](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/transfer-call/warm-transfer.md): Configure traditional warm transfer modes in the Vapi Dashboard or API, including messages, summaries, operator-first timing, TwiML, and timeouts.
- [Configure assistant-based warm transfer](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/assistant-based-warm-transfer.md): Configure an assistant-based warm transfer in the Vapi Dashboard or API, including operator prompts, fallback behavior, summaries, custom audio, and testing.
- [Handoff tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/squads/handoff.md): Transfer a Vapi call between assistants with the handoff tool, covering destination types, context management, and configuration for multi-agent squads.
- [Configure handoff destinations](https://docs.vapi.ai/squads/handoff/destinations.md): Declare handoff destinations by assistant ID or name, offer the model several options, resolve one at runtime by webhook, or hand off to a whole squad.
- [Pass context and variables](https://docs.vapi.ai/squads/handoff/context-and-variables.md): Choose how much conversation history the receiving assistant sees, and extract variables so structured data follows the caller into the next assistant.
- [Configure messages and rejection rules](https://docs.vapi.ai/squads/handoff/messages-and-rejection.md): Set the messages an assistant speaks at each phase of a handoff, and block handoff attempts using regex, Liquid, or grouped conditions on conversation state.
- [Troubleshoot handoffs](https://docs.vapi.ai/squads/handoff/troubleshooting.md): Fix handoffs that never fire or route to the wrong assistant, starting with the system prompt instructions that tell the model when to call the handoff tool.
- [Voicemail tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/voicemail-tool.md): Give a Vapi assistant direct control over voicemail with the voicemail tool, deciding when it reaches voicemail to leave a message or end the call.
- [Configure the Voicemail tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/voicemail-tool/configure.md): Create a Vapi voicemail tool in the Dashboard or API, attach it to an assistant, prompt for voicemail detection, and set the message for each behavior mode.
- [Client-side tools (Web SDK)](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/client-side-websdk.md): Handle Vapi tool calls entirely in the browser with the Web SDK, triggering UI side effects like notifications or state changes without a server URL.
- [Knowledge bases](https://docs.vapi.ai/knowledge-base.md): Create and integrate knowledge bases into Vapi voice agents so they retrieve information from your documents to answer questions accurately during a call.
- [Query tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/knowledge-base/using-query-tool.md): Configure the Vapi query tool to give an assistant access to a knowledge base, retrieving information from your files by ID for accurate, grounded responses.
- [Custom knowledge base](https://docs.vapi.ai/knowledge-base/custom-knowledge-base.md): Build a custom knowledge base in Vapi with your own retrieval server, using your vector database or search logic to control how an assistant finds answers.
- [Implement the custom endpoint](https://docs.vapi.ai/knowledge-base/implement-custom-endpoint.md): Handle the Vapi knowledge base request on your own server, return documents or a direct answer, integrate a vector database, and harden the endpoint.
- [Integrations](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/integrations.md): Connect a Vapi assistant to Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Slack, or GoHighLevel using prebuilt integration tools that need no server of your own.
- [Google Calendar](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/google-calendar.md): Connect a Vapi assistant to Google Calendar to create events by voice and check availability, letting it schedule appointments during a call.
- [Google Sheets](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/google-sheets.md): Connect a Vapi assistant to Google Sheets to add new rows during phone calls, recording caller information and data directly into your spreadsheets.
- [Slack](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/slack.md): Connect a Vapi assistant to Slack to send messages to a configured channel during phone calls, notifying your team or sharing updates in real time.
- [GoHighLevel](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/go-high-level.md): Connect a Vapi assistant to GoHighLevel to manage appointments, checking contacts, creating leads, querying calendar availability, and booking events.
- [Static variables and aliases](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/static-variables-and-aliases.md): Inject server-controlled values into Vapi tool calls without the LLM, using static variables and aliases to chain data across calls deterministically.
- [How tool variables work](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/static-variables-and-aliases/how-variables-work.md): Compare a tool's function.parameters schema against its top-level parameters array, and classify every variable source with Vapi's three-tier trust model.
- [Set static parameters](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/static-variables-and-aliases/static-parameters.md): Add static parameters to API Request and Function tools, use them as a security boundary against prompt injection, and set Static Body Fields in the dashboard.
- [Extract and chain values](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/static-variables-and-aliases/extract-and-chain.md): Define a variableExtractionPlan with aliases, chain tools so one tool's output feeds the next deterministically, and forward trusted values across handoffs.
- [Troubleshoot tool variables](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/static-variables-and-aliases/troubleshooting.md): Fix static parameter and alias failures caused by trusted fields declared in function.parameters, values in body schema defaults, or system prompt passing.
- [Tool rejection plan](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/tool-rejection-plan.md): Prevent unintended Vapi tool calls with a rejection plan that evaluates recent conversation state and blocks a tool when your conditions are met.
- [Tool argument encryption](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/encryption.md): Encrypt sensitive tool arguments like SSNs and card numbers in Vapi, protecting specific fields before they are sent to your server during a tool call.
- [Troubleshoot tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/custom-tools-troubleshooting.md): Resolve common issues with custom tool integrations
- [GPT-Live](https://docs.vapi.ai/gpt-live/overview.md): Learn what GPT-Live brings to Vapi, how its speaker and reasoner work together, and where to start with conversation design, configuration, and compatibility.
- [Design your GPT-Live assistant](https://docs.vapi.ai/gpt-live/design.md): Design GPT-Live conversations with speaker and reasoner roles, outcome-based delegation, useful overlap during tools, flexible pacing, and personality packs.
- [Configure GPT-Live](https://docs.vapi.ai/gpt-live/configuration.md): Configure a GPT-Live assistant in Vapi using the dashboard or API, with speaker and reasoner settings, voice samples, tools, call connections, and analysis.
- [GPT-Live limitations and FAQs](https://docs.vapi.ai/gpt-live/limitations.md): Check GPT-Live support for squads, call control, commentary injection, transfers, simulations, voices, fallbacks, recordings, and post-call data in Vapi.
- [Keywords and keyterm prompting](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-keywords.md): Boost Vapi transcription accuracy for domain terms and proper nouns using Deepgram keyword boosting and AssemblyAI keyterm prompting on your assistant.
- [Custom voices](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-voices/custom-voice.md): Use a custom voice from any supported provider in Vapi by setting the voice property in your assistant configuration with the provider's voice details.
- [ElevenLabs](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-voices/elevenlabs.md): Set up a custom or cloned ElevenLabs voice in Vapi, subscribing to an ElevenLabs API plan and adding your API key and voice ID to your assistant.
- [PlayHT](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-voices/playht.md): Set up a custom PlayHT voice in Vapi, subscribing to a PlayHT API plan and adding your credentials and voice details to your assistant configuration.
- [Cartesia](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-voices/cartesia.md): Use a custom Cartesia voice in Vapi by connecting your Cartesia API key and selecting your voice.
- [Gandr](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-voices/gandr.md): Wire Gandr, a text to speech API for voice agents, into Vapi with the custom-voice provider and Custom Credentials.
- [Custom transcriber](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-transcriber.md): Integrate your own transcription service with Vapi instead of a built-in provider, using a custom transcriber, shown here with a Deepgram setup.
- [Gradium](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-transcriber/gradium.md): Stream Vapi call audio to Gradium's real-time speech-to-text over a WebSocket bridge.
- [Custom TTS integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-voices/custom-tts.md): Integrate your own text-to-speech system with Vapi for full control over voice synthesis, using any TTS provider while keeping real-time performance.
- [Gradium](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-tts/gradium.md): Connect the Gradium text-to-speech API to Vapi through a custom voice endpoint.
- [Fine-tuned OpenAI models](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-llm/fine-tuned-openai-models.md): Use fine-tuned or OpenAI-compatible models as your Vapi LLM, connecting endpoints like OpenRouter, Together AI, or your own server to power an assistant.
- [Connecting Your Custom LLM to Vapi: A Comprehensive Guide](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-llm/using-your-server.md): Connect your own server as a custom LLM in Vapi, walking through an OpenAI-compatible setup with Ngrok to handle the request and response flow end to end.
- [Custom LLM Tool Calling Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/tool-calling-integration.md): Add tool calling to a custom LLM in Vapi so your model can trigger external functions and actions mid-conversation, with the request and response format.

- [SIP networking and firewall configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/sip-networking.md): Configure your firewall and network for Vapi SIP trunks, with the IP addresses, ports, and protocols needed to allow SIP signaling and RTP media traffic.

- [DIDWW SIP integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/didww.md): Set up DIDWW SIP trunking with Vapi. Create inbound and outbound trunks, allowlist signaling IPs, and configure authenticated SIP REFER call transfers.
- [didlogic SIP integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/didlogic.md): Configure didlogic and Vapi for inbound calls, outbound calls, and SIP REFER transfers.
- [Zadarma SIP Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/zadarma.md): Connect a Zadarma SIP trunk to Vapi for inbound and outbound calls, walking through the setup so your AI voice assistants can handle Zadarma calls.
- [Plivo SIP Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/plivo.md): Connect a Plivo SIP trunk to your Vapi agents for inbound and outbound calls, covering trunk setup and routing between Plivo and Vapi.
- [Amazon Chime SDK SIP Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/amazon-chime.md): Integrate Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector with Vapi for inbound and outbound SIP trunking, connecting an AI assistant to a phone number without Lambda logic.
- [Troubleshoot SIP trunk credential errors](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/troubleshoot-sip-trunk-credential-errors.md): Resolve the SIP gateway creation failed error when creating a BYO SIP trunk credential in Vapi, covering the common causes and how to fix each one.
- [Troubleshoot SIP response codes](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/troubleshoot-sip-response-codes.md): Diagnose SIP response codes by response class, failure point, and call direction, then check the relevant Vapi, provider, network, or destination configuration.
- [Phone Number Hooks](https://docs.vapi.ai/phone-numbers/phone-number-hooks.md): Configure phone number hooks in Vapi to run actions on call events, currently the call.ringing event, by defining them in a phone number's hooks array.

- [Live Call Control](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-features.md): Control live Vapi calls in real time with Call Control to inject conversation elements and Call Listen to stream call audio over a WebSocket connection.
- [Customer Join Timeout](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/customer-join-timeout.md): Set maximum time for users to join web calls before automatic termination
- [Voicemail Detection](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/voicemail-detection.md): Detect voicemail on outbound Vapi calls to handle it faster and more flexibly, keeping your voice agents efficient when a call reaches an answering machine.
- [Dynamic call transfers](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-dynamic-transfers.md): Learn how Vapi's dynamic call transfers work and explore implementation patterns for intelligent call routing.
- [Call Handling with Vapi and Twilio](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-handling-with-vapi-and-twilio.md): Keep a caller on hold while dialing a specialist using Vapi and Twilio, with a fallback action when the specialist misses the call or it reaches voicemail.
- [Debug call forwarding drops](https://docs.vapi.ai/phone-calling/in-call-control/transfer-calls/debug-forwarding-drops.md): Troubleshoot Vapi calls that drop immediately after a transfer, finding why forwarding disconnects both parties and how to resolve the underlying cause.
- [Call queue management with Twilio](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-queue-management.md): Build a call queue system using Twilio to handle large volumes of calls while respecting Vapi concurrency limits, ensuring no calls are dropped.
- [Understanding Call Concurrency](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-concurrency.md): Learn how concurrency slots work, how to stay within the default limit, and how to raise capacity for larger campaigns.
- [Call ended reasons](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-ended-reason.md): Understand Vapi endedReason codes that explain why a call ended, where to find them in call logs and the Call object, and how to diagnose each one.
- [Troubleshoot call errors](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/troubleshoot-call-errors.md): Diagnose failed Vapi calls by what the caller experienced, with errors organized by symptom so you can jump to the right fix for each call failure.
- [Call analysis](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/call-analysis.md): Automatically summarize and evaluate every Vapi call after it ends, using an LLM to generate summaries, extract structured data, and score calls for quality.

- [PCI Compliance](https://docs.vapi.ai/security-and-privacy/pci.md): How Vapi handles payment data securely on its voice AI platform, explaining PCI compliance and the practices that protect sensitive financial information.
- [Proxy server guide](https://docs.vapi.ai/security-and-privacy/proxy-server.md): Keep Vapi assistant configs and API keys on your backend by routing Web SDK calls through a proxy server that maps frontend data to Vapi API calls.
- [Static IP addresses](https://docs.vapi.ai/security-and-privacy/static-ip-addresses.md): Route Vapi's outbound HTTP requests through a fixed set of static IP addresses, so you can allowlist them and apply strict firewall and network rules.
- [TCPA Consent Guide](https://docs.vapi.ai/tcpa-consent.md): Understand TCPA consent requirements for outbound Vapi calls, including prior express written consent for marketing and prior express consent for other calls.
- [MCP tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/mcp.md): Connect a Vapi assistant to MCP servers to access tools dynamically at runtime, letting it use any MCP-compatible server's capabilities during a call.
- [Vapi MCP Server](https://docs.vapi.ai/sdk/mcp-server.md): Use the Vapi MCP Server to expose Vapi APIs as tools over the Model Context Protocol, managing assistants, phone numbers, and calls from any MCP client.
- [Ecosystem](https://docs.vapi.ai/resources.md): Explore the Vapi ecosystem in one place, with links to the CLI, client and server SDKs, code examples, MCP server, API reference, and community resources.
- [Project integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/cli/init.md): Initialize Vapi in your existing projects with intelligent auto-detection
- [MCP integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/cli/mcp.md): Turn your IDE into a Vapi expert with Model Context Protocol
- [Local webhook testing](https://docs.vapi.ai/cli/webhook.md): Forward webhooks to your local development server with vapi listen
- [Authentication management](https://docs.vapi.ai/cli/auth.md): Manage multiple Vapi accounts and environments with the CLI
- [What's New?](https://docs.vapi.ai/whats-new.md)
- [What's New? (all entries)](https://docs.vapi.ai/whats-new/llms.txt)
